There's no escape for three of the villagers as they work out that their lives are in serious danger. Ben comes up with a plan to try and snare Trevor. Diane and Tony hope to get their fairytale ending.
Grace wants Esther to give her one last chance to be a mum. Darren is suspicious about Jack's behaviour.

The Osborne family are furious with Jack's decision. A new family shows up in the village. Grace panics after an old friend tracks her down and she scared that her secret could be about to be revealed.
The Roscoe family are lest feeling broken following what happened at Hollyoaks Pride. Jack hands over the keys to the pub. Lockie needs a favour from Leela as he attempts to help Cameron.

After an unwelcome visitor shows up in the village, it looks like Ellie's plans are ruined. Tegan and Ste receive a nasty surprise after they turn up for Cameron's sentencing. Scott manages to get on the wrong side of Tony.

Cameron will stop at nothing in order to ensure that he is still part of Peri's life. Lockie fears for Porsche who is struggling to come to terms with what she has discovered. Lisa decides to come clean.

Patrick lays the final pieces in place of his plan. Joe has second thoughts about his love life. Darren tries to sweep a lucky lady off their feet.
Maxine doesn't know whether to keep her promise as the day of the ceremony is here. Nico makes a discovery.

Maxine finds herself getting closer to the edge, as Patrick casts a dark shadow over the family. Nancy spots a meeting between two ex-lovers, leaving her heartbroken. Sienna rushes to try and save Nico.
Darren and Maxine are in over their heads as the lies spiral out of control. Tony takes on Alfie at the Hutch. Ellie thinks she has found out Cindy's secret.
Cindy knows her secret is a ticking time bomb as Mac and Neeta prepare to take their vows. Harry and Myra come together to get Cleo back on the right path. Tony makes a discovery.
Ben is suspicious of Darren's story. Cleo discovers the past is hard to get over. Dirk and Holly turn their back on Cindy.
Cindy is promised a lifeline by a new face in the village. Alfie feels rejected as Tony wants to keep his secret buried. Harry finds out why Cleo has been behaving the way she has and he's furious.

A villager returns unannounced, throwing a spanner in the works for the loved-up Lomaxes. Holly and Robbie's affair is taken to the next level. Pete uses dirty tactics to try and get back into the good books.
Cameron and Leela's passionate moment is ruined. Cindy and Ellie lock horns over Mac's past. Holly may have to reveal all to Jason.

Cameron feels the pressure to prove himself at the Mr and Mrs Contest held at the Dog. Pete tries to keep Cleo in the palm of his hand. Harry crumbles and Tony blames Ste, causing their rift to grow deeper.
Lindsey has a new plan in mind to sabotage Mercedes and Joe's relationship.
Grace tries to prove a point. Louis thinks that Mrs St Claire's anger may lead her into doing something drastic.
Mercedes become suspicious. Lindsey's scheme begins to work.
The whole community is on the line as Trevor's case heads to court. Ben may of lost his job.
Ben grows angry. Grace and Esther are shocked by the latest development in Trevor's case.
Grace doesn't know if she's ran out of time to find Trevor. Ellie overhears Myra's secret and decides to have some fun with it. Nancy puts her foot in it. Alfie tries comforting Jade.
Jade's 16th birthday party goes off with a bang as she waits on some life-changing news with the Osbornes.

Ellie's mischief threatens to ruin two relationships. Nancy believes that Darren is hiding something. DS Thorpe has fresh news on Patrick's disappearance and shares kit with Sienna, Nico and Maxine. Two villagers can't fight their feelings anymore.
Cindy needs James more then she realises. Maxine is frightened when she hears a voice from the past at Patrick's memorial. Joanne has news for Simon that makes Louis heart sink.
Maxine continues to be spooked by strange occurrences. Nancy tries to get Darren's attention again. Joanna feels rejected by Louis and so decides to plot her revenge.

eps.t: Face to Face with the Enemy
eps.d: Simone gives Louis the silent treatment. Jade's putting on a front that soon collapses behind closed doors. Mac can't believe the lengths Cindy is going to in order to ruin him.
It may be a little too late for a peace offering to be made by Tony to Harry. Maxine is summoned by Mrs St Claire alongside Nancy and Sienna. Mac feels the pressure.

Lindsey faces up to the glove handed killer's witness. Alfie struggles to come to terms with recent revelations. Darren and Nancy have some bad news for Charlie, but they soon discover he's hiding a dark secret of his own.

Celine wants Tegan to be a part of the new hospital poster campaign. A familiar face makes their return to the Dog. Lindsey takes drastic measures by eyeing up her next victim, hoping to not be put in the frame for the other murders.
Trevor isn't happy about been in trouble with the law again. Lindsey see's an opportunity that she can't miss. Celine, Kim and Tegan are surprised at the new face on the hospital posters.
Jason thinks he's walked in on Holly cheating on him. Tegan is spooked when she has a visitor at the hospital. Lindsey gets a call from beyond the grave.
Kim is terrified when she hears what Lindsey has planned next. Robbie, Jason and Joe think they may of seen a ghost. Trevor struggles with what's going on in his head.
Darren and Trevor get their wires crossed as Daren gets defensive about Grace. Alfie comes up with a plan to help Grace with her book report. Ellie has feelings for someone.
John Paul realises he has to choose between his head and his heart. Ellie sets her sights on her next suitor. Simone has to make a choice between family life and work.
There's a dramatic showdown between Ben and Trevor in the Loft. Joanne has a plan to get Louis to herself. Cleo asks for a job at the Hutch.
Grace will stop at nothing until she gets her revenge. Simone's lies are exposed leading to a confrontation between her and Louis. Theresa is mortified when she finds Zack in bed with someone.

Reenie is suspicious when she discovers that Pete has been talking to the police. Marnie sets her sights on the Hutch. Zack is red-faced about his night of passion and is concerned whether Theresa will keep it quiet.
Cleo lands in turmoil with Tony, as she binds over Pete. Zack opens up about his feelings. Marnie and James seize an opportunity to progress in their plan.
Cindy saves the day as Holly and Jason's wedding reaches crisis point. Marnie and James discover the way to bring down the Hutch. Tony pities Cleo.

eps.t: You Can Leave Your Hat On
eps.d: Holly is jealous when Robbie hires a stripper for Jason's stag do. Dirk comes to the rescue at the Dog. Pete is attacked by a hooded figure.
Holly is forced to choose between the two brothers on her wedding day to Jason. Joe makes a discovery that makes him think twice about Lindsey. Diane isn't happy about what Scott is hiding.
Alfie doesn't know what secrets his broken laptop is hiding and is determined to fix it. Jason and Holly are devastated. Scott hopes to save the day when Tony reveals all to Diane.
Freddie remembers something which means the game might be up for Lindsey. Alfie tries to face his fears at the charity abseil. Peri isn't happy when Cameron gets strict.
Lindsey thinks she has a way to silence Freddie and prepares a syringe. Cameron and Peri get confrontational. Alfie and Jade get swept up in the moment.
Cameron tries winning Peri back. Alfie and Jade's romance blossoms. Jack receives a bizarre delivery.

Jade is shocked at the cancer support day. The villagers reel as another suspect in the murder cases is arrested. Lindsey comes face to face with a visitor. James hopes Scott will form part of his plan that will spell disaster for The Hutch.

Darren tries to get to the bottom of were Jade's money has gone. Lisa ignores her feelings for Zack as Simone sets him up on a dating site. Nathan finds out about James and Marnie's plans of sabotaging The Hutch.

Things get steamy between Zack and Lisa. Simone discovers something shocking. Darren falls back into old habits, but he's trying to do the right thing. Tony tries to save the Hutch, Alfie discovers something heart-breaking.

Lisa worries that her secret may be exposed when a face from the past reappears. Ben tries to find a kidney donor for Nico. Grace can't sympathise with Trevor's PTSD, as he grows ever closer to Sienna.
Sienna and Trevor continue to try and push off their feelings for one another. Joanne finds a way back in with the Lovedays. Nico puts her plan into action.

John Paul deceives Mrs St Claire, but who is the mystery new man? Cameron finds Tegan in an awkward situation, he is determined to discover what she is hiding. Tony decides to resort to desperte measures to try and save The Hutch.

John Paul is convinced someone has a crush on him but is he going to be able to avoid his admirer? Darren is nervous when Tony's new business venture threatens to expose dark secrets. Disater strikes as Scott messes around in The Hutch.

Myra is left stunned by a shocking discovery. Alfie attempts to do the right thing when he's faced with the return of his cancer. John Paul helps pick up the pieces, and is surprised to lern there is more to happy-go-lucky Scott.
Joanne threatens to expose Lisa's identity. Diego is stunned to discover Myra's has been twisting the truth. Alfie and Jade stand united against their cancer.
Myra braces herself for financial windfall. Rachel pushes Alfie to tell his family the truth. Lisa pleads with Joanne to keep her secrets.

Louis is in shock as his suspicions about Joanne spiral out of control. A case of mistaken identity has humiliating consequences for Steve. Elsewhere Jason is left heartbroken after yet another revelation.
Jason clashes with Holly and the Savages at The Hutch. Simone supports her husband's claims. Kim asks Esther for a favour.
Lisa attempts to come clean about her true identity. Ste and Harry's relationship is put to the test. Esther is shocked to discover a surprising secret about Lindsey.
Alfie finally finds out about his test results. Rachel is feeling guilty about going behind the Nightingales' backs. Elsewhere Ellie offers Cindy a beauty treatment.
The Nightingales pull together after a revelation. Marnie overhears a conversation she is able to use to her advantage. Holly is left shocked by Robbie's suggestion.

It's a race against time for Holly as she puts her life in danger to follow her heart. Robbie and Jason have an important decision to make, and hot newcomer Liam sets pulses galloping when he meets Tegan and Celine.

Following a high-speed chase, there's terror as a car explodes - but who's trapped inside? Celine wastes no time in showing the new villager to the hot tub, but could there be romance on the cards for Tegan too?

Alfie prepares for his first chemo session, and Jade has news about her own diagnosis. Liam ends up in a pickle when his double-crossing is finally exposed. Freddie has his heart set on Ellie, but does she feel the same?

Celine is determined to get her man, but a surprising intervention leaves her heartbroken. Lindsey's on edge when Esther comes clean about her visit to Kath, and a canny Marnie advises Ellie not to trust Freddie.

Mercedes arrives back in the village, and she wants answers. Kim is terrified that Lindsey is feeling murderous again. Freddie plans to take Ellie on another date, but Marnie gives him food for thought - what hold does she have over him?
Darren spins a web of lies when he's caught out. A furious Freddie overhears a hushed conversation, and Mercedes's suspicions are growing, but will her fears be taken seriously?

Kim's world begins to crumble when she realises she has been betrayed. Joe prepares a romantic setting for his proposal, unaware that he is in grave danger. Tegan and Celine join forces in a bid to get revenge.
Esther fights for Kim's innocence, Joe is derailed by Mercedes's latest claims and Lindsey's escape from Hollyoaks takes a wicked turn.
The Osbornes wait for Frankie to return, unaware of what's happened. Meanwhile, Esther attempts to be the hero and Lindsey threatens to kill again.
As Frankie's life hangs in the balance, will Lindsey make her great escape? When his romantic gesture turns sour, Zack comes clean about his true feelings. Cindy attempts to play Cupid.
Sienna worries that Nico is on to her as she tries to get a confession. Simone and Louis try to patch things up, but there's a huge shock in store for them when a secret is finally revealed.

The Lovedays are in crisis following the shock revelation. Sienna and Trevor's illicit love affair hots up, but is Grace about to catch them red-handed? Ste and Harry vow to cheer up Grace, with hilarious consequences.
Louis, Simone and DS Thorpe turn up to interrogate Joanne. Sienna and Trevor plan to leave Hollyoaks together - will they get their happy ending? Ste and Harry contemplate a night sleeping rough.
Darren's concerned about Maxine - can she keep quiet about their terrible secret? Joanne meets up with Margaret, who abducted Lisa all those years ago. James catches Ste and Harry in a bind.
Darren and Nancy worry that someone knows their secret - who could it be? Marnie warns Freddie to stay away from Ellie. Esther cringes as Frankie tries to put her own stamp on The Magic Bean.

Things turn sinister when the Osbornes receive another blackmail note. Grieving Nathan gets drunk and lashes out at Holly, and Freddie puts his heart on the line to impress Ellie - but will she give him one last chance?
It's the day of Rachel's funeral and Nathan is overwhelmed with emotion. Marnie warns Freddie to stay away from her daughter, and Kim is a nervous wreck waiting for Lindsey to pounce.
Esther encourages Kim to do the right thing, and Leela's new business venture is a success until Ste meddles with his ulterior motives. Nathan demands that Cleo face justice.

Cleo struggles to deal with the fall-out from the crash, but when Pete tempts her with an offer, will she be able to resist? Simone is knocked for six when she returns to a nightmare in her home. Kim gets another text from Lindsey - what will she do?
Tony watches helplessly as The Hutch crumbles. Myra warns Sally to stay away from their son. When Holly's suspicions over Cleo grow, nothing prepares her for what she discovers.

Scott is devastated after overhearing a private conversation, while Holly realises she needs to make a sacrifice to save Cleo from Pete. Harry is blown away by an indecent proposal, but will he be tempted?
Manipulative Marnie convinces Scott to take desperate measures to help Tony, while Zack locks horns with James. Ste's temper gets the better of him, but could Cameron end up having the last laugh?

After a night in the cells, Ste's luck goes from bad to worse as a blast from his past arrives in the village. Scott is playing with fire as he tries to help Tony, while 'Dirty' Harry makes a decision that could end things with Ste once and for all.

The morning after the night before, foiled fire starter Scott discovers Marnie's true intentions and guilt-ridden Harry has cash in hand - but at what cost? Distrustful Sonia and Zack steal Joanne's laptop, never suspecting the secret they find hidden among her emails.

Love is in the air as Frankie sets Esther up with an unexpected date, while Bridezillas Grace and Sienna exchange a war of words; but can Sienna keep her feelings for Trevor under wraps? And, as Joanne comes clean, the Lovedays' world is rocked by an unexpected arrival.

Sparks fly when the real Lisa Loveday comes face to face with identity-stealing Sonia, while Grace and Sienna argue over their wedding dress crisis. Kim asks Esther for another chance but does she have an ulterior motive?

Lisa is refusing to let go of her life with Margaret, but the Lovedays are ready to fight for their daughter. Sienna feels like the walls are closing in as her wedding day draws closer. When Ellie and Freddie play Cupid have they unwittingly put baby JJ in danger?

Lindsey goes to desperate measures to get closer to JJ, while Freddie and Ellie's attempt at a romantic night in is thwarted. Trevor is shocked to discover that Sienna is babysitting Curtis - what is she up to?
When Sienna rushes to Trevor's aid, will she make him see they're meant to be together? Alfie has a surprise up his sleeve for Jade's last chemo session, but will his plan backfire?

Frankie tries everything in her power to keep Alfie and Jade apart, but does the teenager need her soulmate more than Frankie realises? Leela asks Cameron to cover for her at The Loft. And Sienna tells Trevor that he has to decide who he really wants.
It's the day of Sienna and Ben's wedding, but is she marrying the wrong man? Marnie plays the wolf in sheep's clothing by making an irresistible suggestion.
When John Paul reveals something shocking to Ste, it confirms Ste's growing suspicions. Alfie lends a helping hand to Jade, while Tony puts it all on the line in a bid to save The Hutch.
Scott is heartbroken when he realises John Paul is ashamed of him, while Jade's illness takes a dramatic turn. Ste has an accident, leaving Cameron with a dilemma.
At the hospital, Alfie and Jade face the repercussions of their actions, while Myra and Mrs St Claire lock horns over John Paul. Leela worries about what has happened to Ste.
Tony's troubles cause him to spiral out of control. Myra thinks Sally is interfering in John Paul's life, leading to a face-off. A dangerous villager returns - but what are they up to?

When Mercedes conjures up another get-rich-quick scheme, she meets her match in an unlikely villager. Pete's ultimatum leaves Cleo conflicted, while Silas and Lindsey's wicked plot is in danger of being foiled.
Cleo has a big decision to make and Kim pleads with a shocked Celine and Tegan for their help, while Mercedes is in for a horrible shock.
Scott has a proposition for John Paul. When a petrified Mercedes bares her soul to her old nemesis, it has devastating effects for someone.
A conflicted Freddie has a big decision to make, while things get heated when Myra and Sally St Claire clash. Cleo's actions spark a showdown that exposes a huge secret.
John Paul decides he's had enough and gets tough, Esther comforts Kim, while Tony and Diane are forced to make a life-changing decision.
It's Grace's hen party and Sienna makes a life-changing decision. Scott confesses a secret that has heartbreaking results.
Grace's wedding hits a bump in the road. When Nico's world starts to fall apart, she lands someone with a bombshell, while James attempts to woo his latest conquest.

eps.t: Get Him to the Church on Time
eps.d: It's the wedding of the year, but will the groom make it in time? Can John Paul do enough to save a relationship?
As shocking news spreads across the village, an innocent person finds themself in trouble. Meanwhile, has James made a deal with the devil?
Ellie decides to play Cupid again, but will her arrow hit its target? Celine is forced to become a detective when Cleo tries to outsmart her. Sienna is rocked when a lie is exposed.
It's sentencing day for Cleo and she is nervous as to what the future holds for her. Will Nathan get justice for Rachel? Grace is suspicious when two blasts from her past turn up at her door.
Cindy goes to great lengths to get Dirk back, while Marnie wants to help her son move on with his life. Maxine is on tenterhooks when DS Thorpe gets friendly with Jack.
Will Cindy be able to save the day when The Emporium falls foul of the law? How much longer will Cleo be able to keep Holly's secret? Zack's loyalty is torn between Sonia and Lisa.
As a confident Tony prepares for a job interview, Darren suspects Tom has a crush on Jade, while things come to a head between Sonia and Lisa.

Ste feels dejected when he finds out that Harry has lied to him. Jade and Alfie play Cupid, but is this what Tom really wants? Lisa tells Sonia that she won't stop tormenting her until she leaves for good.
Ste makes a discovery about Harry and James, while Cameron is angry when he thinks Leela is out with another man. Lisa is unhappy when Louis questions her behaviour.

eps.t: You're Cordially Invited To the Launch of...
eps.d: When Louis's suspicions spiral over Lisa, it sparks a breaking point for Simone. Jack and Mac are determined to keep Jade and Alfie apart but the lovestruck teens have other ideas. Fed up with Cameron's angst, Leela decides to have some fun.

Tegan offers Freddie a shoulder to cry on when she sees him struggling. Mercedes does her best domestic goddess impression. Ste has to dig deep to find strength when Cameron leads him into temptation.
Cameron will stop at nothing to chip away at Ste's will power. Will Leela come clean to Tegan? John Paul desperately tries to avoid Sally, but his attitude might put his career on the line.
Mercedes and Joe are faced with a life-changing decision as John Paul prepares to deal with his mistake. Sienna sets her sights on helping Grace, but does she have an ulterior motive?
Diane is left speechless by what she sees at Marnie's flat. Maxine worries that she's let a secret slip, and Grace makes a shocking discovery about Trevor.
As Grace and Sienna prepare for Trevor's funeral, Grace has another visitor in the village. Nancy and Darren play Cupid with Maxine and Dirk - but what will Cindy say?
Trevor's funeral descends into chaos. The walls are closing in for Maxine as Sienna is quizzed about her father. Will Grace let her brothers stay in Hollyoaks?

eps.t: You've Got a Friend in Me
eps.d: Jade is pining for Alfie, and Mac softens towards Marnie. Darren doesn't approve of Maxine's new love interest - will he put a stop to her fresh chance of romance?
It's the day of the sky dive for Alfie and Jade. Cindy will stop at nothing to get Dirk back. Freddie makes a huge mistake, but will he be caught out?

While Alfie prepares to hear more about his treatment, he makes a heart-breaking decision. Nancy and Darren pull out all the stops to end Maxine's romance with Adam. Myra takes a nasty tumble - did she fall or was she pushed?
The McQueens are divided in their loyalty over Myra's fall. James is up to his old tricks when John Paul asks for help. Tony is suspicious about what power Diane has over Marnie.

A distraught Peri sees red after a heart-breaking discovery. Marnie reaches breaking point with Diane and Tony - but what schemes does she have up her sleeve? John Paul is told Sally should prepare for the worst.

Reenie returns to Hollyoaks village, and Scott is on cloud nine after taking the next step in his relationship with John Paul. Marnie urges Freddie to talk to Diane, but will Diane just step up her game?
Cleo is asked to go to the police station to be prepped for Pete's trial. Nathan's date with Holly is ruined when he gets a call from Rachel's family - will he come clean about Rachel's affair?

The McQueens prepare for Pete's trial, but where is Reenie when Cleo needs her most? Holly and Nathan's blossoming relationship is put to the test when Cleo is quizzed in court about the circumstances of Rachel's death.

Will Reenie McQueen's evidence be enough to convince the jury of Pete's guilt, and will she be able to cope with the pressure of cross examination? Cleo packs her bags, and Alfie makes a heart-breaking decision about his relationship with Jade.

Reenie gives Mercedes a clue that might hold the key to the trial, and it's Pete's turn to take the stand. Cleo finds a confidante in Myra, while Celine and Mercedes race against time to try to find damning evidence against Pete.

When James's former lover, Carter, comes to the village, James needs a favour from reliable John Paul, who meanwhile begins to spin a web of lies to Scott. Nancy's opinion of Adam Donovan turns full circle when he plays the hero in her hour of need.

Liam and Jesse come up with a secret scheme to get The Loft thriving again, but will Grace discover the truth? Maxine arrives back from her holiday with some news that will shock the village. James is distracted by seeing Joanne and Carter together - what are they up to?

When there's a suspected break-in at Nightingale's restaurant, crafty Marnie calls for Mac's help. John Paul is itching to see James, while Liam tells Adam about his latest money-making scheme and they then set about convincing Grace that it's a good idea.

eps.t: Like a Puppet on a String
eps.d: Tony informs Harry that he and Diane are moving to France for a while. Marnie continues to come between Neeta and Mac. Jesse makes a beeline for his latest love interest, but could this land him in trouble?
Tony and Diane play Cupid to Harry and Ste, but there's something playing on Ste's mind. A worried Neeta has to force a friend to provide a cover story - what is she hiding?
Ste is struggling with temptation, and when Esther agrees to interview him for a job at The Bean, he enlists Tony's help, but will Ste be in a fit state to cope?

Sienna chases down a thief at Price Slice but is there a surprise in store? Peri lashes out in the most spiteful way after blaming Jade for the chasm between her and Tom. When Sonia gets a date with an unlikely villager, they end up sharing a kiss.

Ste is in over his head as Cameron continues to lead him into temptation. Mercedes and Joe are overwhelmed at being parents to Lexi, while Lisa is enraged and out for revenge when she overhears a hushed conversation about herself.

The leavers' party on the boat is in full swing when Peri lets out a spine-chilling scream. Ste's blood runs cold when he can't find his drugs. Tony has second thoughts about going to France when he finds out his job is for a junior chef.

The Tugboat is searched by the police. Harry discovers that Ste is back on drugs. Diane is having last-minute nerves about saying goodbye to Rose, while Lisa tells the delighted teens that she's booked everyone tickets to Ibiza.
In this special episode, Harry and Tony lock Ste in the house to fight his drug withdrawal. But when the pain and sickness get steadily worse, is Ste strong enough to resist temptation one last time?
Zack encourages Sonia to follow her dreams at HCC, while Kim will stop at nothing to get her job back. Grace manipulates Esther with a favour that could put her friendship with Kim at risk.
When Cleo gets a job at The Dog, she finds herself getting closer to Nathan. Grace offers Esther an intriguing proposal, while Kim's life is in danger when she collapses in a trance-like state.
Celine tries desperately to get through to Kim. Peri continues her cruel campaign. Zack has an ultimatum for his parents - will they give him what he wants, even if it pushes Lisa away?
Peri plays Cupid for Jade and Alfie, but does she have an ulterior motive? Cleo tells Nathan to forgive Holly or forget her - what will he decide?

Maxine is resisting temptation with her new man, while Warren is angry when James demands his payment. Kim throws a dinner party with disastrous results, and Jack begs someone to stay away from his family.
Maxine is ready to open up to her new man, but will she say too much? Warren's emotions are out of control, and Jade finally stands up for herself, with Alfie's help.

It looks like the end of the road for Maxine and Warren, but can Sienna tempt Warren to stay? Nico and Peri set off alone on a camping trip. Darren and Nancy make a shock discovery that could see their world come crashing down. Mac is keeping an eye on Neeta at the salon, but has Jesse got revenge in mind?

It's a race against time for Nancy and Darren as they try to cover their tracks, but will Sienna finally uncover the truth about her father's body? Peri and Nico's fun in the bunker ends in disaster. Neeta helps the Donovans gear up for the salon opening, while Marnie has an idea.

Peri is in grave danger; will help arrive soon? Maxine faces tough questioning at the station as Darren and Nancy go through a testing ordeal. Marnie drags Ellie into her plan to break up Neeta and Mac.

Cameron, Leela, Sienna and Warren team up to find the teens. Nico confesses her darkest secrets to Peri. Alfie worries about his PET scan results as he and Jade assist in the search for Peri and Nico.

Darren allows Maxine and Minnie to stay, much to Nancy's annoyance. Mac is becoming more conscious of the age gap between him and Neeta. As the Osbornes begin a hate campaign against Warren, will it be what finally pushes him to leave Hollyoaks?

Diego's sister Maria shows up at the McQueens' with a hidden agenda. Mac is arrested for assaulting Neeta, but who called the police? Nathan mistakenly thinks Cleo asked him on a date. Kim and Esther try on wedding dresses. Jack deals with secrets from his past.

The Donovans officially open the salon. Cleo doesn't want a big 18th birthday celebration, but Lisa has other ideas. Grace and Frankie team up to sabotage Esther's wedding. Nathan makes a move on Cleo. Meanwhile, Myra is onto Maria and wants answers.

Esther and Kim race to make their wedding happen. Mercedes goes to desperate lengths to protect her family. Nathan flirts with Lisa to repair his friendship with Cleo, but will it work? Joanne and Liam have an unexpected rendezvous.

Mercedes exposes Maria's betrayal. Jesse forces Grace to go to the wedding - with handcuffs! Kim doubts Esther's feelings for her - will she go through with the wedding? Nathan's surprised to see another side of Lisa. Joanne can't take a hint from Liam.

Joe rails against Freddie for losing the garage. Mercedes threatens to reveal Diego's lies to Myra. Esther confronts Grace over her involvement in Kim's disappearance. Joanne loses her mother but finds a potential new man.

Joe's world is turned upside down when he discovers Mercedes and Diego's secret texts. Warren and Freddie come up with a plan to save the garage from repossession. Alfie and Jade ditch Mac for some time alone, while Joanne plans her revenge on Liam.

Legal eagle Joanne offers Joe the benefit of her advice. When Mercedes, Myra and Celine break in to a high-end babywear shop, their heist doesn't quite go to plan. Alfie and Jade agree to sleep together but is it what they both really want? Warren finds a buyer for the camper van but will it be enough to save the garage?

Will Joanne succeed in her attempt to seduce Joe? Marnie scuppers Jade's plans to give Alfie a night to remember. Mac and Sally end up in a camper van bidding war, and Warren is furious when Freddie reduces his share of the profits.

Ellie and Freddie decide to move in together but is their bubble about to burst? The garage is sold, but who is the new owner? James and Joanne have a bet on who can split up a relationship first, while Amy arrives back in the village with some disappointing news from Cindy.
The Nightingale family descend into chaos. Ste struggles to cope on his first day out after rehab and he lashes out when he finds a stranger looming over Leah - but is all as it seems?

As Marnie goes to extreme lengths to stop anyone else finding out her secret, Ellie is stunned by Freddie's romantic declaration. Ste struggles to make amends with Ryan but he soon becomes worried about Leah. Meanwhile, Cleo's playing matchmaker.

Alfie's health takes a turn for the worse, leaving Marnie's plot to crumble. Lisa and Nathan's budding romance looks set to be short-lived with a surprise delivery at The Dog. Ste confides in Tegan about Leah, but does he have it all wrong? Scott wants to take his relationship with John Paul to the next level.
There's havoc in the village as an animal is on the loose. James plots to come between Scott and John Paul. Nancy tries to talk Darren out of another hare-brained scheme, which ends in disaster.

Nancy and Darren struggle in the aftermath of the accident, as Scott worries that he's lost John Paul. Ste tries to make amends with Ryan and Amy, and the teens get their A-Level results. Grace is furious when she finds a reminder of the past, but could her rage lead her to seek revenge?
Emotions run high as the power goes out in the village. Grace seeks the truth as Nathan attempts to get closer to Lisa, and James tries to turn over a new leaf.
Grace is furious and wants revenge. Myra and Sally continue to argue over John Paul - will they ever make a truce? Celine's romantic gesture to Jesse ends with a bit of hotness.

Warren threatens Maxine and Darren, while Grace continues her plan for revenge, but who is she after? Adam and Maxine go on a date and Jesse is avoiding Celine, but why? Nico's obsession with Peri intensifies.

One family waits anxiously at the hospital with a loved one in a life-or-death situation. Things are looking up for Jesse, while Nico tries to get closer to Peri. Meanwhile, Tom uncovers a shocking truth.

Sienna desperately tries to help Warren, while James's plan to assist Joanne is foiled. Joe makes fun of Mercedes and the kids of Hollyoaks High wait with baited breath for their GCSE results. Meanwhile, Nico has a plan to help Peri.
Nico's sinister scheme is coming together. Meanwhile, just as Joe and Mercedes think everything's going to plan, the worst possible thing happens. And Diego finds a way to make John Paul smile.

With Mercedes' world falling apart, Diego tries his best to help her. Peri suspects Nico could be behind Tom's mystery illness, while Myra is floored to learn Diego has a secret. Meanwhile, a stranger arrives in Hollyoaks Village but someone isn't pleased to see them.

Joanne discovers that Joe still has feelings for Mercedes, and Diego locates Maria, who makes him an offer he can't refuse. Meanwhile, Warren tries to get Darren and Maxine to go into business with him. But will Darren make a deal with the devil?

Joanne resorts to desperate measures to keep her man, while Alfie gets a surprise call from his hero. Warren declares war when he discovers Maxine's sabotage plans, but it's Darren and Nancy who are in real trouble when their past comes back to haunt them.

Sienna demands to know the truth, leaving Darren and Nancy fearing for their lives. Neeta worries about her relationship with Mac, while Nico and Peri make a discovery that could change the lives of everyone in the village for ever.

The hunt for a killer is on, but who's the number one suspect? Is it Sienna; out on a rampage and determined to get answers? Is it Daren, Nancy and Maxine; panicking and trapped in their web of lies? Or is it innocent-looking Nico, who's facing tough questions at the police station? DS Armstrong will stop at nothing to find out the truth.

Each episode this week is set on the same day, but shows a different point of view from a suspect in Patrick's murder case. Starting with Maxine. DS Armstrong interrogates Maxine over Patrick's death but Maxine ends up in hospital. Maxine confides in Adam and makes a life-changing decision.

The second episode this week set on the same day, from a different suspect in the murder case is from Nancy's point of view. Darren and Nancy realise they've accidentally set Maxine up for murder. Meanwhile, Nancy has a physical meltdown in front of her class. Later, she pushes Nico for the truth about Patrick's death.

The third episode this week set on the same day, revealed from a different suspect in Patrick's murder case, is from Nico's point of view. A new video recording surfaces and makes Nico the prime suspect. As Nico and Peri plan to run away, Nico prepares to tell Peri everything.

The fourth episode this week set on the same day, from a different suspect in Patrick's murder case is from Warren's point of view. Warren is stunned when Sienna reveals she was prepared to help Patrick die. And the revelations don't stop coming when Warren learns all about her damaged history. Later, as police suspicion turns on Sienna, Warren plans their escape.

The last episode in the week that is set on the same day, telling events from a different suspect in Patrick's murder case, is from Sienna's point of view. The police prepare to make an arrest for Patrick's Murder. Meanwhile Sienna is shocked by a surprise witness statement which changes her life forever.
Mac makes a grand gesture for Neeta but how will Marnie react? Jade makes a discovery, while John Paul has good news for Myra and Sally. But Grace is not happy with a new arrival in Hollyoaks.

Marnie and Neeta agree to be civilised to each other. Can Neeta trust that Mac's issues are in the past? Jade and Alfie seize the day after she tells him her news. Grace is worried that old secrets may be discovered, while James opens up to John Paul about his troubled childhood.

Ellie plays matchmaker but will everything go to plan? Joe takes his relationship with Joanne to the next level, but an unexpected visitor could be a problem. Myra needs a get-rich-quick scheme to fund her wedding of the year to Diego. Jade attempts to run away from her problems, but can Alfie make her see sense?

Joe has a big decision to make. Alfie and Jade attempt to make a lifetime's worth of memories. Myra's scheme is getting out of control, but Jesse sees it as a business opportunity for the salon. James decides to take revenge on the person responsible for his childhood demons.

Can Myra and Jesse pull off the scam of the century? Myra is shocked when Diego reveals his past secrets. Will a discovery ruin Esther and Grace's chance to reconcile their friendship? Joe is in for a surprise but can he talk his way out of trouble? Ste decides on a career change.

Desperate Esther allows Grace to help her - but can they solve the mystery of missing Kim? The Roscoe boys endure the 'meal from hell' with an unwanted guest. A visitor shakes up the McQueens, but it's Jack's past that comes back to haunt him as he receives a mysterious phone call.

Concerned Simone takes desperate measures as Lisa's partying gets out of control. Leah has some harsh words for a devastated Ste, while Jack's forced to face his demons as he visits someone from his past. But just how safe will he be?

Simone hosts a dinner party to try to save her family but, with Marnie invited, will all go as planned? A new arrival in the village puts Cindy's nose out of joint, while suspicious Esther demands answers from Jack, unaware they're both being secretly watched.

Romantic Freddie tries to win back Ellie's heart, while Cleo's heart-broken as Nathan and Lisa are stronger than ever. Cindy thinks her luck is changing, but she soon discovers she has the boss from hell. Esther forces Jack to go to the police, unaware how close the danger is. And the village is in for a treat with new arrival Detective Eva Falco.

Mercedes' mistake has landed Freddie in hot water - can he convince Ellie he loves her? Marnie's determined to stop Lisa and Nathan from moving forward with their relationship, but will enlisting lovelorn Cleo help? Liam falls head over heels for mysterious Eva, but is she all that she seems?
It's Freshers' Week in the village and Lisa persuades Ellie to come out to a Loft party to help get over Freddie. In among the chaos and the party, will it be a night they never forget?
Celine feels trapped by her promise to marry Diego, while Joe has to ask Joanne for a difficult favour. Tegan is desperate for a boyfriend, and Ellie confides a terrible secret.
It's Mercedes and Celine's hen do, complete with McQueen madness, but someone makes a horrible mistake. Nick gets to know Holly, and Joanne schemes about Joe's wedding.

Freddie desperately tries to keep things together for Joe's wedding, while Mercedes is in damage limitation mode. Liam suspects something is up with Celine, as everyone prepares for the double wedding of the year.
Celine prepares to walk down the aisle, Liam and Jesse party in the Loft, and a huge secret is revealed.

Alfie sets up a green screen to take fake holiday snaps for Jade before her hospital appointment, which gives Alfie an idea. Celine tries to help her family as Mercedes has to say a difficult goodbye. Cameron lies to Courtney about Lockie's drug abuse, but she doesn't look set to drop the search just yet.

Nathan gets on the wrong side of Lisa when she overhears him talking about Rachel, and the tension sizzles between Nathan and Cleo when Lisa storms off. Meanwhile, Jade is desperately trying to stay strong and Sonia offers to take her to see their dad.

It's the day of the Little Starz talent show and Leah is in full-on diva mode. Meanwhile, Eva gets Liam involved in a dangerous plan. Cameron's upset with Courtney over her Find Lockie page, and Alfie treats Jade to a French picnic.

Eva lies to Liam about how much trouble they're in - what does she have planned? Leela receives some worrying news at the hospital, and Ste fights to see more of the kids. Cindy is heartbroken when the luxury flat she and Dirk were buying goes up in price.

Liam worries that his actions have put his family in danger, while Leah and Lucas are confused when Ste takes them out of school. For once Marnie is left speechless when she comes face to face with Cindy's sister Jude.

TV stardom beckons for Leah, but chaos ensues when the adults can't behave themselves. Will Ste manage to keep his cool? Jude confronts Jack over past misdemeanours, but is it Liam and Eva he needs to worry about? Nico seeks solace in Warren.

Cameron tries to convince Courtney to stop searching for Lockie, but it's the police who uncover a new development. Cindy looks to team up in business with Jude. Maxine and Warren have to think hard about their future together. It could be a week of bad news for Ste concerning his health and family.

Cameron is asked by the police to help with a new development in the disappearance of Lockie. Cindy is furious when her career is scuppered by somebody close to home, but there could be a silver lining. Nancy and Adam try to warn Maxine about taking a dangerous backwards step. Tony helps Ste come up with a plan to solve his family issues.

Jude's business is hit by a wave of opposition, but can she appease the troublemakers? Despite Adam and Maxine's lies, Warren discovers some big news. Neeta is struggling with life, post-Mac. Cameron delivers a shocking lie to his family, but will Nico and Peri discover the truth?

Maxine seeks the truth on a prison visit to Sienna. Peri and Nico's plan for revenge on Cameron has horrific consequences. Things get a bit messy at Mercedes' birthday bash, while James attempts to help Neeta against Mac, but will Marnie spoil their plans?

eps.t: 50 Years of Marriage Draw to an End
eps.d: Mercedes is astounded when she receives news from the police that could be a game changer for her and Joe. Nico and Peri's Cameron prank has devastating consequences for two villagers.

Nico is horrified to discover just what Warren has in store for Cameron, and she and Maxine rush to stop him. Celine tricks Cleo into draft a love-letter to Nathan, which she later forwards on to him in an email. Elsewhere Mercedes embarks on a mission to win back her man, but Joanne has other ideas.

Joanne accuses Mercedes of attacking her, and Celine confesses to Cleo that she sent her heartfelt letter to Nathan. Alfie and Jade plan a golden wedding anniversary to tick off their married couple bucket list, but tensions are high at the Osborne house.

The tensions in the Osborne household explode as Frankie blames Alfie for Jade's sudden decline. Cleo is given a glimmer of hope when Nathan asks her to meet him for a chat, and Mercedes is furious when she receives an injunction from Joe. Meanwhile, Jude and Cindy realise just how much Tom needs his sisters, and they spend the day reminiscing together.
Alfie and Jade remain committed to enjoying what is left of their time together.
As Myra worries about the future, Nana returns to lift her spirits. Mac is furious when he discovers Neeta's filed for divorce with James's help. Alfie comes to terms with upsetting news.
John Paul tries to encourage James to patch things up with his family. It's a tough day for Sonia when someone from her past appears. And Myra is on the hunt for a new baby daddy.
James is angry at John Paul for meddling. Peri struggles to contain her guilt over Maxine. Sonia has a difficult decision to make as Simone and Lisa remain at loggerheads.
John Paul encourages James to get some counselling; can they patch things up? Things go from bad to worse for the Lovedays as Lisa makes a rash decision; will Simone ever forgive her?
Cindy starts working for Jude again, but will she uncover the scam? Leela and Cameron desperately search for Peri. Joanne revels in Mercedes' misery when she sees her with Joe and the kids.
With her crimes exposed, the hunt is on for Nico. Will jailbird Sienna help catch her deadly daughter? And Joe has a surprise in store for Mercedes, but will it go to plan?
Joanne leaves Joe's plans up in the air, while Jesse and Celine get lost in a maze, then in each other's arms. Cameron's out for revenge, but Nico is on the loose and has murder in mind.
Sparks are flying between loved-up Joe and Mercedes. Jesse feels guilty as the Spooktacular is devastated by disaster, while Cindy and Jude have seduction on their minds.
It's the morning after the horror of Halloween and Sienna finds an unlikely shoulder to cry on. Freddie faces new responsibilities, and Nancy reveals a painful secret to her family.
Joanne makes a terrible discovery and plans revenge on Mercedes. Cindy and Dirk's luck seems to have changed, but can they enjoy their good fortune when Sally is left out of pocket?
Cindy is panicked by the Osbornes' disappearance. Liam is worried about what Eva has done, and Grace finds out something shocking.
Maxine is stunned by an unexpected offer, and Cindy swears to find out the truth about the Osbornes. Nick comes up with a plan, and Louis wants to support Simone.
Myra is floored by a surprise arrival, while Simone gets bad news, which Joanne tries to capitalise on. Maxine worries that Adam is about to do something drastic.
Cameron stresses when Courtney tries to get 'Lockie's' body released from the mortuary, and Leela is given a new task. Louis is worried that Simone's drinking is getting out of hand.
Marnie is out for blood when she finds out about Jude's scam, Cameron worries about Leela, and Myra reaches her breaking point. Courtney and Tegan hatch a plan.

Can John Paul persuade James to help free Diego from prison? A determined Warren vows to find out who set the maze on fire, and Marnie is shocked when she discovers who James has contacted to help with her money problems.
Cameron makes a shocking discovery that he plans to use to his advantage. James concocts a devious plan, but will it work? Tony is sceptical when Marnie asks him for a favour.

Joel welcomes a newcomer to the church, but they're not all that they seem. Alfie accuses Cindy of only wanting a relationship with him when it suits her, and Goldie resorts to desperate measures to get what she wants.
Cindy is delighted when a familiar face returns to the village. Liam finds himself the victim of blackmail, and Joel is concerned by his new parishioner's thirst for revenge.

When a clue about the disappearance of the Osbornes emerges, who will get there first? Cindy and Grace? Or Eva? Simone is heartbroken when she finds out who Lisa has been visiting. Are Myra's new houseguests too much to handle?

Mac is furious when a surprise visitor comes to town, while at Nightingales, Tony is on the menu for one lucky lady. Liam goes to extremes to protect Grace, and Nathan feels awkward as he calls on Cleo for a favour. Ellie's desperate attempt to reach out to Freddie backfires.

As Nick and Holly grow closer, Nick decides it's time to get Ellie off his back. Can Harry convince Ste to accept help from an enemy? Marnie's stuck in the middle of a family feud, Lisa drops a bombshell on Cleo, and will a night out end in tears for Amy and Ryan?

Marnie's desperate to make up with Mac, Ellie fights for Freddie, and Nathan worries when he discovers Lisa's at the hospital. Ste and Amy bond over a bad tan, but can he change her mind about the custody battle?

Louis receives some shocking news. It's Prince and Hunter's first day at Hollyoaks High, but how smoothly will it go? A message from Nathan sends Lisa into a panic, while Sienna's revenge is on hold as Warren has his eyes on her. It's the day of Ste's custody hearing, but will it go ahead?

Marnie has a plan to sabotage Nathan and Lisa's relationship, but Mac takes a different approach. Goldie's furious when Prince and Hunter don't keep their promise, and Harry's pleas to Ste fall on deaf ears.

Warren and Ste team up against a common enemy. Leah is furious about her acting debut, and Joanne gains new recruits to help her win Louis back. Meanwhile, Ellie breaks Mercedes' heart with news from Sandy.

Goldie figures out Mercedes' plan, but can she stop Ellie from calling the police? Joanne comes to the rescue when Louis gets into trouble. Meanwhile, Warren and Ste have another plan to catch out their enemy, and Sienna plays the victim.

Lisa and Zack confront Prince about his accusations, and Joanne gets Louis exactly where she wants him. Simone visits Margaret in prison, and Ryan is tempted by the McQueen charm. John Paul gets the wrong end of the stick when James makes him an offer.

Celine and John Paul are in a rut, and they decide a McQueen night out is what they need. But Celine has other plans for an oblivious John Paul. James makes John Paul a tempting offer but has James thought it through?

Celine has exciting news for Cleo and Tegan, and Jesse is in for a shock. Is Celine playing with fire when she sends Cameron a text? Meanwhile, Leela's not happy about the wedding dress choices so wants to postpone the wedding - but how will Cameron feel?

Celine is terrified to find a hidden message, and Cameron is furious when Leela drops a bombshell about the wedding. Adam helps set up the Christmas lights in the village but gets his festivities mixed up. Mercedes confronts Joanne about Joe's death and Ste fights for his kids once again.

As the Christmas fair continues, Jesse wonders why Celine is ignoring him, and Adam takes a hit. Later, Cameron's temper lands him in trouble. Ste goes to extreme lengths to make Leah happy, but what will the consequences be for him? Meanwhile, Adam surprises Maxine.

Leela throws a Christmas party, but where is Cameron? Nick and Tegan discover each other's secrets. Cleo receives news about Celine, and Ste turns to Tony for help. It's Adam's birthday, but what is he hiding?

Tegan vows to help Cleo, and Leah ends up in hospital after an accident in the village. After a visit from Ste, Leah has a plan in mind. Tracey returns for Adam's birthday but things quickly turn sour. Nick finds Tegan's anti-anxiety pills in her handbag.

Tegan is having withdrawal symptoms, and Nick stops her making a dangerous mistake at the hospital. Tegan heads to the drugs cupboard, but Kim is in there too and reveals she's in danger. Later, Nick catches Tegan and thinks she's stealing medication. Leah finds a selfie and text from Goldie on Ryan's phone.

Nick catches Tegan deleting CCTV footage of Kim and persuades her to speak to Eva. Grace and Tracey have different views on Maxine, and Alfie can't stand the thought of Christmas without Jade. Ellie finds out about Holly and Nick and spills all to Dirk.

Grace finds stolen cash and an empty vodka bottle in Tracey's bag - could this be the last straw? Alfie lets slip to Cindy about him talking to Jade, and Nick reassures Holly that he'll speak to Ellie.

Just as Ellie starts to feel herself again, she discovers Holly and Nick in one of the toilet cubicles at The Dog. Alfie storms over to Cindy's flat when he finds out that she's been speaking to Mac about her concerns, but he gets some news he wasn't expecting.

After the previous day's events, Ellie is struggling and ends up collapsing after a party at The Dog. She is horrified when she ends up in hospital and Nick is on duty. Alfie follows in his sister's footsteps, and James and Neeta prepare for a battle in court against Mac.

Neeta attends an interview for the teaching assistant job, and Sally lets her sit in on a class. However, Prince and Hunter make sure they don't give her an easy ride. Mac and Marnie are worried about Ellie, while Ellie wants to tell Freddie about Nick. OB is on a mission to find out more about Eva, and asks Grace for help.

Sienna visits Joel at church but is left frustrated when he doesn't acknowledge her advances. Lisa panics when she hears about tensions at The Dog, and Nick carefully approaches Ellie to see if they can make a fresh start.

Prince breaks into the garage and watches as Warren showers Sienna with gifts. But when Sienna feeds Warren a lie, Prince overhears and later reveals the truth. John Paul leaves Matthew Jesus with James for the day, but it doesn't end well. Leela prepares for her hen do, and Lisa tells Cleo she's going to break up with Nathan.

Tegan livens up Leela's hen party with a stripper, but it doesn't go down well with Cameron. Leela asks him to leave, and Cameron ends up writing a confession letter. Alfie decides to spend Christmas with Cindy, while Dirk plans to spend Jude's scam money. Sienna tells Warren that she has a stalker from the church, and Scott is delighted by something he hears.

It's Cameron and Leela's wedding day, but will Leela discover Cameron's crimes? Warren swears to find Sienna's stalker, and Cindy catches Holly and Nick in the back of Dirk's van. Someone is upstairs at the Roscoes', and the McQueens' Christmas includes a few extra guests.

Joel offers to spend the day with Warren, but when they walk into The Dog together, Sienna hides. At the McQueens', James promises to try harder for John Paul and Matthew Jesus. James and Scott play Christmas party games, but Scott's blatant flirting with John Paul annoys James.

Sienna persuades Warren to bury Nico's ashes at the memorial garden, but when they arrive there's a fright in store. Leah continues to try to tear Ryan and Amy apart, and Amy pales when she gets a note through the door.
Amy confronts Ryan with the note. Ryan gets increasingly angry at how Leah is wrapping her mum around her little finger. Grace organises a dinner, and Simone and Louis return to the village.
Amy throws Ryan out of the house, and pressure mounts among the Osbornes. Mercedes and Goldie's duvet day ends with some stealing and an unexpected guest.

It's New Year's Eve, and more drama hits the Osborne family. Goldie warns Prince and Hunter to stay out of trouble, while Mercedes tries to sneak Ryan out after their night together. The twins ignore their mum and drag Harry into their mischief - will they get in the way of Harry's proposal to Ste?

Tom is guilt-ridden, and comes up with a plan to help Sally make up for the money Jude stole. Sienna has to hide when Warren invites Joel to the flat, and Ryan tells Mercedes he's being blackmailed about their night together - but by whom?

Sienna is being hassled by Joel, but when Warren refuses to let her leave Hollyoaks, she steps up her revenge plan. Diego is desperate to win Myra back, while Myra gets a confession out of Cindy. Marnie gives Jesse money to take Ellie out, but Ellie is horrified when she misunderstands Jesse's intentions.

Freddie offers Ellie his new apartment to move into when she decides to leave The Dog. Adam and Jesse are swamped at the salon, and Goldie lies that she's a qualified hairdresser and gives Holly a striking new look. Cindy ends up in a fight with the McQueens, and Joel confronts Sienna.

Marnie reveals a heart-breaking secret to Ellie that stops her moving into Freddie's flat. Jesse offers Goldie a job as salon receptionist when she spins him a sob story about needing money for her sons. They go for a few drinks and he walks her home.

Scott returns from holiday to find that Diane is back, but Diane and Tony are dressed for a funeral. Diane has brought her niece Lily to stay, but Tony isn't keen on the idea of a new arrival. He's forced to apologise to Lily when she overhears - can he convince her to stay?

It's Ste's birthday and he wants to see his kids. Prince and Hunter are out for revenge when Amy bans them from The Bean. Lily immediately catches the eye of another classmate on her first day of school.
Adam finds out that Liam is keeping secrets about Darcy. Amy is reported to Social Services, but by who? Neeta makes a breakthrough with Lily.

Liam tells Adam what he knows about Darcy. Amy tries to defend herself to Social Services, while Ryan gets a lead on who reported her. Nathan plans a private cinema treat for Cleo in the Love Boat. However, Lisa spots them together and boils with jealousy.

Ste finds out about Ryan sleeping around. Lisa confronts Nathan about his cosy night with Cleo, and tells Cleo to stay away from Nathan. Goldie shows Mercedes the dating app she's on, but Mercedes is furious when she sees James Nightingale has a profile.

Lisa wants Nathan to choose between her and Cleo. Someone burgles The Dog, and Lisa and Mac are locked in the cellar. Nathan returns to The Dog and catches the masked intruder trying to get into the safe.

Prince engineers things so that he and Lily are paired together for a science project, and Kim is put out over Esther and Grace's relationship. Esther lashes out, and Lisa and Mac feel guilty. Mac thinks he knows who broke into the pub.

Kim makes a panicked phone call to Grace asking her to get to the hospital. When Grace and Adam arrive, a team of nurses rush to Esther's room. Ellie surprises Marnie at the hospital and Courtney catches Lily and Prince getting close.

Ellie quarrels with Freddie, and Tegan realises something about Daniel. Things are awkward between Louis and Leela in Price Slice but Louis is intrigued when Tegan reveals they're registering Daniel today.

Esther is still struggling with her memory, but Nancy has an idea. Nancy tells Darren that her test results have arrived. Leela feels guilty when Peri admits that she needs her dad. Daniel's father turns up at the hospital, and Freddie is furious at Ellie.

Leela worries about who overheard her in the hospital. Nathan forgets Lisa's birthday and she is furious. Nancy has an important appointment at the hospital. Ellie questions Freddie about why he's been AWOL all day.
Things take a sinister turn when Courtney throws Tegan's phone in the water and disturbs something lurking beneath. Warren surprises Ste, while Lisa chooses between Mac and Nathan once again.
Nathan is worrying about his relationship while Mac has something else on his mind. Tegan makes a grim discovery, while Courtney tries to call the police. Meanwhile, Ryan and Ste join forces.
History repeats itself when Zack goes missing and Simone begins to panic. Simone receives some worrying news from Harry, while Ryan is on the case to help find Zack.
Ste gives Harry the cold shoulder. Ryan and Ste are back to square one with the kids. And Harry gets the wrong end of the stick with Goldie.
It's Ryan's birthday but things become awkward when Amy invites the McQueens. Joel refuses Warren's gesture of reconciliation which leads to an unexpected reunion.
Liam is taken back by an emotional Grace, while Esther explodes with anger over an upcoming change. Ste and Harry are worried about Amy, and Ryan has a new idea in mind.
Prince is searching for relationship advice but what he finds brings back bad memories for Goldie. Harry is preparing a surprise for Ste, while Grace tells Esther her true feelings.
Kim plans a surprise for Esther, but Esther is confused by a note she finds. And Kim doesn't get the reaction she was hoping for.
Grace's emotions put her off a scheme, but could that all change? Nancy prepares to tell people about her illness, but something stops her in her tracks.
Darren worries when Nancy and Courtney go head-to-head. Liam is determined to get revenge while Tom discovers something in Esther and Kim's flat. Maxine receives some information.
Darren worries when Nancy and Courtney go head-to-head. Liam is determined to get revenge while Tom discovers something in Esther and Kim's flat. Maxine receives some information.
Diane makes sacrifices for Lily, but is there someone else in her life? Nancy is struggling, while Jack asks Mac for some shifts to take his mind off things.
John Paul finds Lily looking at a website that worries him so he goes to speak to Diane. Later, Lily gets a shock and Jack begs Frankie for some affection.
Lisa is still worried that she and Mac are going to get caught for past mistakes, but Mac tries to reassure her. Meanwhile, Jack goes to court.
Tony notices something is troubling Diane, while Cindy and Marnie prepare for Hilton's birthday party. Holly is heartbroken when she sees Alfie crying in his room after speaking to Jade.
Nana and Bart McQueen return to the village, where Nathan makes an announcement. Myra thinks she's going into labour, while Holly hears Nick being disrespectful about her.
Myra is stunned by Sally's revelation. The McQueens and Jesse gather for Celine's funeral. Cleo is struggling to hold onto her feelings for Nathan, while Myra receives a shock.
